description: Focuses on deploying embedded machine learning and real-time AI models on resource-constrained edge Internet of Things (IoT) hardware and sensor networks.
learning_objectives: Master the architecture, protocols, and edge-cloud interplay in Artificial Internet of Things (AIoT).
Design and optimize TinyML models using pruning, quantization, and specialized edge runtimes.
Interface IoT streaming protocols (MQTT, CoAP) with AI inference pipelines.
Build end-to-end smart applications in smart cities, industrial automation, and healthcare monitoring.
outline: AIoT Fundamentals: Architecture, intersection of AI and IoT, edge computing vs. cloud computing, low-latency inferencing.
IoT Protocols & Data Acquisition: MQTT, CoAP, BLE, LoRaWAN, time-series sensor stream ingestion.
Embedded Edge AI (TinyML): Model pruning, post-training quantization, TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers, Edge TPU, ONNX runtime.
Domain Applications: Smart cities, Industry 4.0 predictive maintenance, connected healthcare, autonomous transportation.
AIoT Platforms & System Lifecycle: Device management, firmware over-the-air (FOTA) updates, security, edge project deployment.
